spans.s: Cut, divided, rent, chopped, riven, torn, broken.

Exhausted, tired, fatigued.-न्ना A whore, harlot. -Comp. -केश a. shorn, shaven.-द्रुमः a riven tree. -द्वैध a. whose doubt is dispelled.-नासिक a. noseless. -भिन्न a. cut up through and through, mutilated, mangled, cut up. -मस्त, -मस्तकa. decapitated. (-स्ता, -का) a headless form of Durgā.-मूल a. cut up by the roots;
. -श्वासः a kind of asthma. -संशय a. 'one whose doubt is dispelled', free from doubt, confirmed.
